title: Singularity Layer MCP
description: MCP for Singularity Layer - discover listings, manage assets, run payment flows, and use agents
summary: MCP for Singularity Layer - discover listings, manage assets, run payment flows, and use agents
offersHint: MCP for Singularity Layer - discover listings, manage assets, run payment flows, and use agents · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.x402layer.cc/mcp

toolsPreview.name: browse_marketplace
toolsPreview.description: Browse and search the Singularity Marketplace with various filters. Returns listings of endpoints, products, and agentic services.

toolsPreview.name: get_listing
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a specific marketplace listing by its slug.

toolsPreview.name: get_featured
toolsPreview.description: Get featured marketplace listings (endpoints and products highlighted by the platform).

toolsPreview.name: get_top_rated
toolsPreview.description: Get top-rated marketplace listings sorted by average rating.

toolsPreview.name: get_agent
toolsPreview.description: Get details for a specific ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 agent by network and identifier.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List all available marketplace categories.

toolsPreview.name: list_networks
toolsPreview.description: List all supported blockchain networks.

toolsPreview.name: list_agents
toolsPreview.description: List all registered ERC-8004 and Solana-8004 agents.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_endpoints
toolsPreview.description: List the endpoints accessible to the dashboard owner behind your MCP access token or endpoint API key. PATs are preferred for owner-wide inventory and require mcp:read or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_campaigns
toolsPreview.description: List fundraiser campaigns owned by the dashboard user behind your MCP personal access token. Requires mcp:read or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: create_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Create a fundraiser campaign owned by the dashboard user behind your MCP personal access token. Requires mcp:campaigns:write or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: update_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Update allowlisted fundraiser campaign fields such as title, description, x handle, images, and links. Requires mcp:campaigns:write or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: update_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: Update allowlisted endpoint fields such as metadata, pricing, listing flags, imagery, wallet, payment options, slug, and webhook settings. PATs are preferred and require mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_products
toolsPreview.description: List the products owned by the same dashboard user as your MCP access token or endpoint API key. PATs are preferred and require mcp:read or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: update_product
toolsPreview.description: Update allowlisted product fields including metadata, pricing, listing state, payment options, wallet, branding, and slug. PATs are preferred and require mcp:products:write or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: get_endpoint_details
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for an endpoint you own, including credit balance, pricing config, and wallet address. PATs are preferred and require mcp:read or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: get_endpoint_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get usage analytics for an endpoint: total requests, monthly requests, revenue, and success rate. PATs or endpoint API keys improve accuracy. PATs require mcp:read or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: set_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Set or update the webhook URL for an endpoint. Returns a signing secret that must be saved. PATs are preferred and require mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: remove_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Remove the webhook URL from an endpoint. PATs are preferred and require mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: delete_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: ⚠️ DESTRUCTIVE: Permanently delete an endpoint. Cannot be undone. Only works for agent-created endpoints. PATs are preferred and require mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: request_endpoint_creation_payment
toolsPreview.description: Return the x402 payment challenge needed to create a new agent endpoint. Requires a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: create_endpoint_with_payment
toolsPreview.description: Create a new agent endpoint after you have obtained a valid X-Payment payload for the creation challenge. Requires a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:*.

toolsPreview.name: request_endpoint_topup_payment
toolsPreview.description: Return the x402 payment challenge needed to top up credits for an existing agent endpoint. Accepts either a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:* or a legacy endpoint API key.

toolsPreview.name: topup_endpoint_with_payment
toolsPreview.description: Complete an endpoint credit top-up after you have obtained a valid X-Payment payload. Accepts either a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:* or a legacy endpoint API key.

toolsPreview.name: request_product_purchase_payment
toolsPreview.description: Return the x402 payment challenge for purchasing a public product. This wraps the existing public /p/:id-or-slug flow and does not require owner credentials.

toolsPreview.name: purchase_product_with_payment
toolsPreview.description: Complete a public product purchase after you have obtained a valid X-Payment payload for that product challenge.

toolsPreview.name: request_endpoint_credit_purchase_payment
toolsPreview.description: Return the x402 payment challenge for purchasing a public credit pack from an endpoint that exposes /e/:slug?action=purchase.

toolsPreview.name: purchase_endpoint_credits_with_payment
toolsPreview.description: Complete a public endpoint credit-pack purchase after you have obtained a valid X-Payment payload for the purchase challenge.

toolsPreview.name: get_agent_registry_info
toolsPreview.description: Get public ERC-8004 / Solana-8004 registry information, supported networks, worker routes, and wallet-first notes.

toolsPreview.name: request_agent_wallet_challenge
toolsPreview.description: Create a wallet-auth challenge for ERC-8004 agent registration or management. The wallet owner must sign the returned message locally; MCP does not sign with the wallet.

toolsPreview.name: verify_agent_wallet_challenge
toolsPreview.description: Verify a wallet-signed auth challenge and receive a short-lived session token for agent registry flows.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_agent_bindable_endpoints
toolsPreview.description: List platform endpoints owned by the authenticated wallet or linked dashboard user that can be bound to ERC-8004 agents.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_registered_agents
toolsPreview.description: List ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 agents owned by the authenticated wallet or linked dashboard user.

toolsPreview.name: prepare_agent_registration
toolsPreview.description: Prepare a wallet-first ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 registration. The caller must later send the on-chain transaction from the same wallet and then call finalize_agent_registration.

toolsPreview.name: finalize_agent_registration
toolsPreview.description: Finalize a wallet-first agent registration after the on-chain transaction has been sent from the same wallet.

toolsPreview.name: prepare_agent_update
toolsPreview.description: Prepare a wallet-first update for an existing ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 agent. If metadata changes require an on-chain URI update, the response describes that action.

toolsPreview.name: finalize_agent_update
toolsPreview.description: Finalize a wallet-first update for an existing ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 agent after any required on-chain transaction has been sent from the same wallet.

toolsPreview.name: submit_agent_feedback
toolsPreview.description: Submit on-chain ERC-8004 or Solana-8004 reputation feedback through the worker feedback route. This requires the separate worker feedback API key, not a wallet session token.
